title: CorrelationMeter - atomic rho read, colored bar, mono-cancellation flash
description:
Wave-2 correlation meter component. Independent of GoniometerComponent; depends on d.1 only for shared colours/style.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §9.3 (correlation display colours, peak-toward-−1 flash)
- Source/DSP/MeterTap.h getCorrelation / atomic ρ read API from phase C
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.* from d.1

Implement Source/GUI/CorrelationMeter.h/.cpp as a juce::Component:
1. UI-thread only: read smoothed ρ from MeterTap (std::atomic<float> load) or a float source pointer set by the editor. Never write the audio-thread estimator.
2. Horizontal bar meter spanning −1…+1, geometric center at 0.
3. Colour bands (fill from 0 toward current ρ):
   - green for +1 … +0.3
   - yellow for +0.3 … −0.3
   - red for < −0.3 (mono-cancellation warning)
4. Held peak-toward-−1 indicator: when ρ dips low (toward −1 / through red band), flash or hold a peak marker that decays slowly so brief mono-collapse danger is visible.
5. Labels or tick marks at −1, 0, +1 optional but recommended; paint allocation-light.

Do not implement Goniometer, PluginEditor layout, or CMakeLists.
acceptance_criteria: CorrelationMeter reads smoothed rho via atomic/float source (MeterTap getCorrelation or equivalent) on the UI path only
Horizontal bar is centered at 0 over the range -1..+1
Held peak-toward--1 flash/indicator present for mono-cancellation warning
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/MeterTap.* implementation (consume public API only)
modify Source/PluginEditor.*, Source/PluginProcessor.*, Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.*, Source/GUI/RotarySlider.*, Source/GUI/GoniometerComponent.*
recompute Pearson correlation on the UI thread instead of reading the published atomic

allowed: choose peak-hold decay time and flash style
bind via MeterTap* or std::atomic<float>* setter
